name: RaceBox EVO
tagline: The RaceBox you know. Now at 25 Hz.

description: RaceBox EVO is the next generation of the original standalone RaceBox: the same windscreen-mounted unit with its own colour screen, now with 25 Hz GPS, a larger battery and more internal storage. Lap timing and drag runs on the device, no phone needed.

highlights.title: 25 Hz, on the dash
highlights.body: 25 Hz GPS instead of 10 Hz, with live lap, sector and drag results on its own colour screen.

highlights.title: Bigger battery
highlights.body: A larger battery than the original RaceBox. Capacity and runtime are confirmed before shipping.

highlights.title: More storage
highlights.body: More room for sessions on the device itself. The final figure is confirmed before shipping.

highlights.title: Same shape you know
highlights.body: The windscreen-mounted design and four-button controls of the original RaceBox.

Will you keep me updated while I wait?
Yes. We email production updates while you wait. If the ship date moves, we email you the new date before the old one passes: keep your place or cancel for a full refund.
Should I wait for EVO or buy the RaceBox now?

If you want it before March 2027, the RaceBox ships now, with the same shape and controls at 10 Hz. EVO adds 25 Hz GPS, a larger battery and more storage. On a motorcycle, the Mini S is the better fit: EVO is built for cars.
Will my RaceBox accessories fit EVO?
EVO has the same shape as the original RaceBox. Which accessories fit is confirmed before it ships.
What will EVO cost after pre-order?
